we propose an approach for integrating the ratings and the trust relationships in social networks to improve the performance of recommender systems.

we propose a new collaborative filtering method that uses the trust relationships between users and a denoising Autoencoder to model user preferences more accurately, which improves the performance of recommendations.

we propose a new method to extract implicit trust relationships between the users and use the trust relationships together with the rating information to improve the quality and the accuracy of recommendations.

the problem of trust-aware collaborative filtering, where we propose two neural models for integrating both the explicit trust relationships and the implicit trust relationships to enhance the recommendation quality.
the following questions: How can we use trust relationships between users to improve the recommendation quality of collaborative filtering?
the problem of improving collaborative filtering by incorporating trust information.

the proposed model can effectively fuse the trust information with the ratings information to improve the quality and accuracy of the recommendations.
the trust information can be effectively integrated with the ratings information for modeling the preferences of users in the social recommender system.

our proposed TDAE++ model can effectively extract both explicit and implicit trust relationships between different users and fuse them together to learn more reliable representations for improving recommendation performance.

we proposed two neural network models, TDAE and TDAE++, which are based on the denoising autoencoders and the trust relationships between users to enhance the performance of the collaborative filtering.
